purpose: Session-sized completion roadmap for finishing the repository without restarting completed work.
completion_definition: All phases are complete, their acceptance checks pass, and the final release audit documents any intentionally unresolved external-data limitations.
rules: One phase should normally fit one substantial implementation session and end in a validated push.
Do not mix unrelated data acquisition, UI redesign and methodology research in the same phase unless they share one acceptance surface.
Every phase must leave main deployable even if later phases are unfinished.
Source-backed data and Demo content must remain visibly distinct.
Do not reopen completed geography, Sprint 1, Sprint 2, Sprint 3, World Bank or County Life work unless a regression or documented data correction requires it.
Prefer generated views over new parallel data stores.
A phase is complete only after deterministic build/test checks pass and GitHub Pages deploys successfully where the phase touches the website.

phases.title: Runtime stabilization and CountyIQ sample fallback
phases.session_goal: Keep CountyIQ usable when production fetches fail and expose sample mature-product structure without presenting synthetic values as facts.
acceptance: CountyIQ scripts parse
production data remains first choice
fallback does not replace the whole page
Demo values are clearly labelled
Pages deployment succeeds

phases.title: Initial-load performance and shared registry loader
phases.session_goal: Remove duplicated multi-megabyte registry downloads and ensure the Atlas shell becomes interactive before heavy map/data work begins.
outputs: deferred heavy observation loading where possible
acceptance: app, compare and map do not independently fetch the same master registries
map still works at all four geography levels
main page remains usable if D3 or heavy registries are unavailable
npm test passes

phases.title: CountyIQ canonical analytical mart
phases.session_goal: Generate one 47-county CountyIQ data product from the canonical Atlas registries and stop joining Sprint CSVs in the browser.
acceptance: 47/47 counties
source period unit provenance retained
deterministic rebuild
direct Sprint CSV joins removed from production CountyIQ

phases.title: County fiscal history and denominator discipline
phases.session_goal: Surface the strongest existing historical county dataset and add only defensible population-adjusted measures.
outputs: population/per-capita measures only where periods support them
acceptance: 47 counties x 12 fiscal years represented
no silent denominator interpolation
fiscal trend UI works on mobile
rankings use common periods

phases.title: County health and living-standards ingestion
phases.session_goal: Activate a coherent first social-outcomes package from already identified official sources.
acceptance: no survey estimate activated without required uncertainty metadata
coverage published honestly
headline rankings respect coverage threshold
native registry validation passes

phases.title: County education, economy, agriculture and infrastructure breadth
phases.session_goal: Close the largest domain gaps using only county-comparable primary data.
acceptance: at least 20 CountyIQ-eligible active indicators across at least five domains
national indicators are never inherited to counties
all new indicators have catalogue and provenance records

phases.title: Peer groups, percentiles and trend intelligence
phases.session_goal: Make county comparison structurally fair and time-aware before any overall index is published.
acceptance: peer membership reproducible from published rules/inputs
trend calculations require comparable periods
no peer group implies quality judgement

phases.title: Development Gap Calculator and evidence narrative engine
phases.session_goal: Turn differences from national/peer benchmarks into transparent, non-causal decision intelligence.
acceptance: every gap exposes formula, source, period and denominator
no unsupported monetary opportunity claim
narratives are reproducible from displayed statistics

phases.title: County Development & Performance Index research release
phases.session_goal: Build the composite as a research product with explicit statistical diagnostics rather than as a marketing score.
acceptance: methodology published
sensitivity materially tested
robustness range displayed
research/beta label remains until historical gate passes

phases.title: Historical index validation and release decision
phases.session_goal: Determine whether the composite is stable enough to become a normal CountyIQ result.
acceptance: historical limitations explicit
material rank instability disclosed
production label only if release gates pass

phases.title: County government delivery and accountability layer
phases.session_goal: Separate government-linked delivery from broad county outcomes.
acceptance: only government-linked measures enter delivery score
audit/fiscal sources traceable
broad county outcomes are not automatically attributed to the governor

phases.title: Administration scorecards and evidence-based recognition
phases.session_goal: Restore leadership/recognition features using reproducible rules and strong attribution cautions.
acceptance: no personal governor causal score from broad outcomes
recognition generated from published rules
all periods and sources visible

phases.title: Canonical Convergence & Governance
phases.session_goal: Centralize static indicator semantics so every Atlas build, analytical product and comparison surface derives domain, direction, ranking mode, uncertainty, trend, inheritance, publication and cross-level rules from one versioned policy layer.
outputs: policy drift validator wired into npm test
acceptance: all 98 indicator policy rows reproduce from one executable policy module
all CountyIQ metrics mirror canonical static policy
all published series-level cross-geography decisions mirror canonical normalisation rules
parent-to-child value inheritance remains prohibited
full Atlas validation and independent geometry audit pass

phases.title: County Evidence & Knowledge Hub
phases.session_goal: Make every county profile a durable evidence doorway to official planning, budget, accountability and statistical documents, with explicit found/not-published/not-found/inaccessible states.
outputs: county evidence UI and search hooks
acceptance: 47/47 counties have a verified CIDP record or an explicit evidence-state reason
at least three additional core document families are indexed wherever officially published
document type county period source page and verification state are recorded
no placeholder links are presented as evidence
broken or inaccessible links are distinguished from documents not found or not published

phases.title: Action & Opportunity Finder Beta
phases.session_goal: Connect CountyIQ gaps and county context to a verified, date-aware opportunity registry without presenting stale or speculative funding information as live.
acceptance: every live record has a primary URL verification date and next-review state
expired paused unknown and closed programmes cannot appear as live
deadline and amount claims are source-backed
match rationale is reproducible from published county gaps and programme rules

phases.title: Data distribution and developer surface
phases.session_goal: Package canonical registries, policy and analytical products into a stable public data interface with versioned machine-readable contracts.
outputs: developer documentation and reproducible example queries
acceptance: downloads map to documented releases and checksums
canonical data and analytical methodology versions are distinguishable
schema changes are versioned
developer examples reproduce published values

phases.title: Real-browser accessibility, SEO and performance release audit
phases.session_goal: Harden the public product with real-browser, accessibility, performance and link-integrity gates rather than DOM-only smoke checks.
acceptance: critical journeys pass in Chromium Firefox and WebKit without uncaught runtime errors
critical accessibility failures are closed
performance budgets pass for core cold-load routes
broken-link audit is reproducible
known browser and SEO limitations are documented

phases.title: Final reproducibility, governance and v1.0 release
phases.session_goal: Close the repository against one final completion ledger and publish a defensible v1.0 state only after reproducibility, real-browser and deployment gates pass.
outputs: all validators and browser release gates
acceptance: build:data clean with no committed-output drift
npm test and real-browser release audit clean
geometry audit clean
GitHub Pages deploys the exact release commit successfully
post-deployment smoke test passes
no required completion gate is silently deferred
